title: 凡是…都… — every / all
explanation: 凡是 (fánshì) means 'every / all that …'; the 都 clause states what is true of every such case.

examples.zh: 凡是努力的人,都会有收获。
examples.pinyin: fán shì nǔ lì de rén , dōu huì yǒu shōu huò 。
examples.en: Everyone who works hard will gain something.

examples.zh: 凡是来过这里的人,都说好。
examples.pinyin: fán shì lái guò zhè lǐ de rén , dōu shuō hǎo 。
examples.en: Everyone who has been here says it's good.

examples.zh: 凡是重要的事,都要认真对待。
examples.pinyin: fán shì zhòng yào de shì , dōu yào rèn zhēn duì dài 。
examples.en: Every important matter must be taken seriously.

examples.zh: 凡是他答应的事,都会做到。
examples.pinyin: fán shì tā dā ying de shì , dōu huì zuò dào 。
examples.en: Everything he promises, he does.

title: 除非…否则… — unless
explanation: 除非 (chúfēi) states the only condition; 否则 gives what happens without it: 'unless …, otherwise …'. 除非…才 is a positive variant.
syllabus_ref: 复句·条件复句：除非……，否则/不然……

examples.zh: 除非你同意,否则我不会去。
examples.pinyin: chú fēi nǐ tóng yì , fǒu zé wǒ bù huì qù 。
examples.en: Unless you agree, I won't go.

examples.zh: 除非下雨,否则比赛照常进行。
examples.pinyin: chú fēi xià yǔ , fǒu zé bǐ sài zhào cháng jìn xíng 。
examples.en: Unless it rains, the match goes on as usual.

examples.zh: 除非亲眼看见,否则他不会相信。
examples.pinyin: chú fēi qīn yǎn kàn jiàn , fǒu zé tā bù huì xiāng xìn 。
examples.en: Unless he sees it himself, he won't believe it.

examples.zh: 除非努力,才能成功。
examples.pinyin: chú fēi nǔ lì , cái néng chéng gōng 。
examples.en: Only by working hard can one succeed.

title: 就算…也… — even if
explanation: 就算 (jiùsuàn) is a colloquial 'even if', like 即使; the 也 clause holds regardless.

examples.zh: 就算失败,我也不后悔。
examples.pinyin: jiù suàn shī bài , wǒ yě bù hòu huǐ 。
examples.en: Even if I fail, I won't regret it.

examples.zh: 就算再贵,他也要买。
examples.pinyin: jiù suàn zài guì , tā yě yào mǎi 。
examples.en: Even if it's expensive, he'll buy it.

examples.zh: 就算你不说,我也知道。
examples.pinyin: jiù suàn nǐ bù shuō , wǒ yě zhī dào 。
examples.en: Even if you don't say it, I know.

examples.zh: 就算困难再大,我们也能克服。
examples.pinyin: jiù suàn kùn nan zài dà , wǒ men yě néng kè fú 。
examples.en: No matter how big the difficulty, we can overcome it.

title: 要么…要么… — either…or
explanation: 要么 (yàome) … 要么 … presents two alternatives: 'either A or B'. It states a choice between two options.
syllabus_ref: 复句·选择复句：要么……，要么……

examples.zh: 周末要么在家休息,要么出去运动。
examples.pinyin: zhōu mò yào me zài jiā xiū xi , yào me chū qù yùn dòng 。
examples.en: On weekends, either rest at home or go out to exercise.

examples.zh: 要么你来,要么我去。
examples.pinyin: yào me nǐ lái , yào me wǒ qù 。
examples.en: Either you come or I go.

examples.zh: 这件事要么做好,要么别做。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì yào me zuò hǎo , yào me bié zuò 。
examples.en: Either do this well, or don't do it.

examples.zh: 要么坐高铁,要么坐飞机,都可以。
examples.pinyin: yào me zuò gāo tiě , yào me zuò fēi jī , dōu kě yǐ 。
examples.en: Either high-speed rail or plane — both work.

title: 以便 — so as to
explanation: 以便 (yǐbiàn) introduces a purpose made easier by the first clause: 'so as to / in order to'.

examples.zh: 请留下电话,以便联系。
examples.pinyin: qǐng liú xia diàn huà , yǐ biàn lián xì 。
examples.en: Please leave your number, so we can contact you.

examples.zh: 他早早到了,以便有时间准备。
examples.pinyin: tā zǎo zǎo dào le , yǐ biàn yǒu shí jiān zhǔn bèi 。
examples.en: He arrived early, so as to have time to prepare.

examples.zh: 把说明写清楚,以便大家理解。
examples.pinyin: bǎ shuō míng xiě qīng chu , yǐ biàn dà jiā lǐ jiě 。
examples.en: Write the instructions clearly, so everyone understands.

examples.zh: 多存点钱,以便将来使用。
examples.pinyin: duō cún diǎn qián , yǐ biàn jiāng lái shǐ yòng 。
examples.en: Save more money, for future use.

title: 哪怕…也… — even if (extreme)
explanation: 哪怕 (nǎpà) supposes even the smallest or most extreme case: 'even if / even just …, still …'.

examples.zh: 哪怕只有一点希望,我们也不放弃。
examples.pinyin: nǎ pà zhǐ yǒu yī diǎn xī wàng , wǒ men yě bù fàng qì 。
examples.en: Even with just a little hope, we won't give up.

examples.zh: 哪怕再忙,他也会抽时间看书。
examples.pinyin: nǎ pà zài máng , tā yě huì chōu shí jiān kàn shū 。
examples.en: No matter how busy, he makes time to read.

examples.zh: 哪怕走得慢一点,也要坚持走完。
examples.pinyin: nǎ pà zǒu de màn yī diǎn , yě yào jiān chí zǒu wán 。
examples.en: Even if walking slowly, finish the walk.

examples.zh: 哪怕别人不理解,她也要坚持自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: nǎ pà bié rén bù lǐ jiě , tā yě yào jiān chí zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ 。
examples.en: Even if others don't understand, she sticks to her idea.

title: 不仅不…反而… — not only not…on the contrary
explanation: 不仅不 (bùjǐn bù) … 反而 (fǎn'ér) … says the opposite of what's expected happened: 'not only did A not happen, on the contrary B'.
syllabus_ref: 复句·递进/转折：不仅不……，反而……

examples.zh: 吃了药,病不仅不好,反而更重了。
examples.pinyin: chī le yào , bìng bù jǐn bù hǎo , fǎn ér gèng chóng le 。
examples.en: After the medicine, the illness not only didn't improve but got worse.

examples.zh: 他不仅不生气,反而笑了。
examples.pinyin: tā bù jǐn bù shēng qì , fǎn ér xiào le 。
examples.en: He not only wasn't angry but laughed instead.

examples.zh: 批评他,他不仅不改,反而更过分了。
examples.pinyin: pī píng tā , tā bù jǐn bù gǎi , fǎn ér gèng guò fèn le 。
examples.en: Criticized, he not only didn't change but went further.

examples.zh: 下了雨,天气不仅不凉,反而更热了。
examples.pinyin: xià le yǔ , tiān qì bù jǐn bù liáng , fǎn ér gèng rè le 。
examples.en: After the rain, it not only didn't cool down but got hotter.

title: 随着 — along with / as
explanation: 随着 (suízhe) marks a change that another change follows: 'as / along with …'. It opens a clause describing a developing situation.
syllabus_ref: 介词·引出依据：随着（表示伴随）

examples.zh: 随着年龄的增长,他变得越来越成熟。
examples.pinyin: suí zhe nián líng de zēng zhǎng , tā biàn de yuè lái yuè chéng shú 。
examples.en: As he grows older, he becomes more mature.

examples.zh: 随着科技的发展,生活越来越方便。
examples.pinyin: suí zhe kē jì de fā zhǎn , shēng huó yuè lái yuè fāng biàn 。
examples.en: As technology develops, life gets more convenient.

examples.zh: 随着时间的推移,一切都会好起来。
examples.pinyin: suí zhe shí jiān de tuī yí , yí qiè dōu huì hǎo qǐ lái 。
examples.en: As time goes by, everything will get better.

examples.zh: 随着经济的发展,城市变化很大。
examples.pinyin: suí zhe jīng jì de fā zhǎn , chéng shì biàn huà hěn dà 。
examples.en: As the economy develops, cities change greatly.
